results.content: ## [Revue de papier] GNN-ACLP: Graph Neural Networks based Analog Circuit Link Prediction. AIPredict missing analog circuit connections and unify diverse netlists with this novel GNN and LLM framework. The paper "GNN-ACLP: Graph Neural Networks based Analog Circuit Link Prediction" introduces a novel approach to automate analog circuit design by predicting missing component connections from incomplete netlists. They formulate the circuit link prediction task as an undirected graph link prediction problem, where nodes represent circuit component ports and edges represent connections. The core problem being addressed is formulated as follows: Given a graph $G = (V, E, \phi)$ representing a netlist (where $V$ is the set of component ports, $E$ is the set of connections, and $\phi(v) \in [k]$ denotes the component type of port $v$), and a graph $G'$ obtained by removing a vertex $u$ from $G$, the goal is to compute the set of neighbors of $u$ in $G$.
